label.en: Begin with a publicly reasoned account of the community’s shared purposes and obligations.
label.zh: 首先公开论证共同体的共同目的和义务。

label.en: I cannot choose between these proposals / not enough information
label.zh: 无法在这两项方案间选择／信息不足

title.en: Economic-left × communitarian: reading these choices
title.zh: 经济左向×共同体优先：本题本读法

headline.en: Compare support for shared provision with support for a common civic life.
headline.zh: 分别看公共供给取舍，以及对共同公民生活的重视。

summary.en: This reading describes a count pattern in two sets of hypothetical policy proposals: more economic-left choices and more communitarian choices. It does not identify a party, a moral character or a position in a real population.
summary.zh: 这份读法说明两组假设政策方案中的次数组合：经济左向方案较多，共同体优先方案也较多。它不指定政党、道德品质或真实人群中的位置。

scoreReading.en: Economic difference = right count minus left count. Social difference = liberal count minus communitarian count. Both differences are negative in this comparison. Each axis needs all eighteen valid choices; any NA leaves that axis unscored.
scoreReading.zh: 经济差值＝右向次数减左向次数；社会差值＝个人自由优先次数减共同体优先次数。本组合的两项差值都为负。每轴十八项全部有效才显示；任一NA使该轴保留不足。

title.en: Two commitments, not one political identity
title.zh: 两种取舍分别看，不合成政治身份

paragraphs.en: A negative economic count difference means that more of your eighteen economic selections favored the proposals this edition calls economic-left. These emphasize public provision, redistribution or a stronger collective role in economic decisions. A negative social difference means more selections favored common civic purposes, inherited public practices or shared obligations. Keeping these dimensions separate matters: a shared service can be organized in several ways, and support for cultural continuity does not determine a tax preference. Neither coordinate measures kindness, obedience or intelligence.
paragraphs.zh: 经济差值为负，表示十八项经济取舍中，本版称作经济左向的方案被选得更多，涉及公共供给、再分配或经济决策中的集体作用。社会差值为负，则表示共同公民目的、公共传统或共同义务一侧的选择更多。两者需要分开理解：同一种公共服务可以采用不同组织方式，重视文化延续也不能自动推出税收偏好。坐标不测善良、服从程度或智力。

title.en: Read the policy instruments behind the counts
title.zh: 回到次数背后的政策工具

paragraphs.en: Look back at which instruments you actually preferred. Public rental housing, progressive taxation and employee representation are different interventions, with different intended beneficiaries and implementation problems. Similarly, a shared civic calendar and a service obligation place different demands on individuals. Selecting them in the same direction does not establish one underlying motive. You may favor one proposal because of access, another because of local continuity, and a third because of distrust of a particular alternative. The summary cannot recover those reasons from a two-option choice.
paragraphs.zh: 公共租赁住房、累进税和雇员治理代表权是不同工具，受益对象与执行难题也不同；共享公民日历和公民服务义务对个人提出的要求同样不同。选项方向相同，不能证明动机相同。一次选择可能为了扩大可及性，另一次为了延续地方记忆，也可能只是因为不信任给出的另一方案。二选一的汇总无法还原这些理由，需要你自己补充。

title.en: Work through a complete example
title.zh: 用完整算例复算

paragraphs.en: Consider a fictional attempt with twelve left and six right selections, plus eleven communitarian and seven liberal selections. The economic difference is six minus twelve, or −6; the social difference is seven minus eleven, or −4. Every axis has eighteen valid choices, so the point is (−6, −4). Changing one economic selection from left to right changes both counts: eleven left and seven right give −4. The social value stays −4. These arithmetic changes describe the bank, not a measured amount of ideological change.
paragraphs.zh: 假设一份答卷选了十二次经济左向、六次右向，以及十一次共同体优先、七次个人自由优先。经济差值为6−12＝−6，社会差值为7−11＝−4；两轴均有十八项有效选择，坐标就是（−6，−4）。把一项经济选择从左向改为右向后，次数变为十一与七，经济差值变为−4，社会差值仍是−4。这是题本计数的变化，不是意识形态变化幅度的测量。

title.en: Keep a tie and missing information distinct
title.zh: 分清边界与资料不足

paragraphs.en: Ten left choices and eight right choices give −2, a narrow count difference rather than a strong identity. If the social choices divide nine to nine, that axis is exactly zero and both left-side comparison guides remain relevant. If one social response is NA, however, there is no social coordinate or combined point. An unanswered question also differs from NA: the questionnaire cannot finish until every question has a selection. Do not replace uncertainty with a middle response merely to obtain a dot on the chart.
paragraphs.zh: 经济左向十次、右向八次得到−2，只表示次数差较小。社会轴若为九比九，差值为零，左侧的两份组合说明都应保留；若其中一题选择NA，则没有社会坐标，也没有组合点。尚未作答又与NA不同：全部题目都作出选择，问卷才可结束。无需为了得到图上的点，把不确定强行改成某一方案。

title.en: A similar economic choice can lead elsewhere
title.zh: 相近经济选择也能形成另一组合

paragraphs.en: Someone may support broadly financed housing and education while opposing an expected civic ceremony and a common cultural quota. Their economic selections could resemble this pattern while their social selections point toward individual freedom. Conversely, a person may value a common civic ritual but prefer private financing of services. Neither is an inconsistent version of this comparison. The two axes deliberately allow these combinations. A real person can also accept public provision for one service and reject it for another without the summary exposing the difference.
paragraphs.zh: 一个人可能支持公共筹资的住房与教育，却反对把公民仪式设为通常要求，也不赞成共同文化配额；经济选择相近，社会方向仍可能不同。另一个人可能重视共同仪式，同时偏好服务的私人筹资。这些都不是本组合的“不一致版本”，两轴本来就允许不同搭配。某人也可能只支持一项服务的公共供给，汇总不能替代逐题差异。

title.en: Keep costs and minority interests in view
title.zh: 同时看成本、异议和少数者处境

paragraphs.en: The proposals describe priorities rather than guaranteed outcomes. A public provider still faces budget limits and accountability questions. A community process may build belonging while making it harder for dissenters to participate on equal terms. Private alternatives can also fail people who lack resources or bargaining power. This guide cannot settle those empirical questions by adding up selections. Ask what safeguards, funding assumptions and opportunities to challenge a decision would be needed under each proposal. That inquiry remains relevant whichever side has the larger count.
paragraphs.zh: 方案表达优先顺序，不保证实际效果。公共供给仍受预算和问责条件约束；共同体程序可能增加归属，也可能让异议者难以平等参与。私人替代方案同样可能无法照顾缺乏资源或议价能力的人。计数不能解决这些经验问题。可以分别检查每项方案需要怎样的保障、筹资假设和异议渠道，而不因为某侧次数较多就跳过这些条件。

title.en: Use one disagreement for closer reading
title.zh: 选择一个分歧，补全自己的理由

paragraphs.en: Choose one economic item and one social item you found difficult. Write what the missing third proposal would look like, whose interests it would protect and what evidence could change your answer. Then compare those notes with the actual two options. This makes the limitation of forced comparisons visible without requiring another test or a political recommendation. You can read all four guides, leave uncertainty in place or end here. Nothing in the result tells you which party, candidate, campaign or community to support.
paragraphs.zh: 挑出一项难选的经济题和一项难选的社会题，写出你希望增加的第三方案：它保护谁，需要什么证据，你又会在什么条件下改变选择。再把笔记与题中两个方案比较，便能看清有限选项的边界。可以阅读全部四份指南、保留不确定，或直接结束；无须继续测试。结果不推荐政党、候选人、政治活动或特定共同体。

title.en: Original edition and privacy limits
title.zh: 原创版本与私人作答边界

paragraphs.en: FermatMind Editorial wrote these thirty-six bilingual policy comparisons and the equal-count rule. Background discussions of distributive justice and the liberal–communitarian debate explain the vocabulary; they do not validate this instrument. This is not the IDRlabs bank, Political Compass, SECS or an 8values conversion. There are no population norms, party predictions or established language equivalence. The public guide contains no personal answers. Copying its link does not publish your point; optional saved progress remains in the current browser tab and is cleared on completion or retake.
paragraphs.zh: 费马测试编辑部编写了本版三十六道双语政策取舍和等权计数规则。分配正义及自由主义与共同体主义讨论只提供词汇背景，不验证本题本。本版不是IDRlabs题库、Political Compass、SECS或8values换算，没有人口常模、政党预测或已确立的跨语言等价证据。公开指南不含个人答案，复制链接不会发布坐标；主动保存的进度仅留在本浏览器标签页，完成或重测会清除。

title.en: Economic Left & Communitarian: Political Coordinates
title.zh: 经济左向×共同体优先：本题本读法｜原创政治坐标

description.en: Read economic-left and communitarian policy choices. Follow a two-axis scoring example, distinguish ties from NA and explore the trade-offs in this guide.
description.zh: 这份读法说明两组假设政策方案中的次数组合：经济左向方案较多，共同体优先方案也较多。它不指定政党、道德品质或真实人群中的位置。

title.en: Economic-left × liberal: reading these choices
title.zh: 经济左向×个人自由优先：本题本读法

headline.en: A preference for shared economic provision can coexist with room for individual civic choice.
headline.zh: 支持更多公共经济供给，也可以同时重视个人的公民选择空间。

summary.en: This comparison links more economic-left selections with more liberal selections on the separate social axis. Read it as a description of the offered proposals, without converting it into a party label or a claim about all your beliefs.
summary.zh: 本组合对应经济左向方案较多、社会轴个人自由优先方案也较多。它描述的是所给方案的选择，不换算成政党标签，也不概括你的全部信念。

scoreReading.en: A negative right-minus-left difference and a positive liberal-minus-communitarian difference locate this comparison. All eighteen choices must be valid on each axis; zero retains adjacent readings and NA prevents an affected-axis coordinate.
scoreReading.zh: 经济的右减左差值为负，社会的个人自由优先减共同体优先差值为正。每轴十八题全部有效才定位；零值保留相邻读法，NA使所属轴不生成坐标。

title.en: Separate economic access from civic autonomy
title.zh: 区分经济资源与公民自主

paragraphs.en: This combination allows economic and social choices to differ in direction. More economic-left selections can express support for public financing, redistribution or collective influence over economic institutions. More liberal social selections can express a preference for neutral rules, voluntary participation and room to question common civic purposes. Those are definitions for this bank’s offered alternatives. The two counts do not show whether you support every public program or reject every tradition. They also say nothing about how successfully a policy would expand either material access or personal freedom.
paragraphs.zh: 这个组合允许经济与社会取舍朝不同方向展开。经济左向选择较多，可能对应公共筹资、再分配或集体参与经济制度；社会轴个人自由优先选择较多，则对应中立规则、自愿参与以及审视共同公民目的的空间。这些是本题本对给定方案的定义，不说明你赞成所有公共项目或反对所有传统，也不能证明政策实际扩大了资源可及性或个人自由。

title.en: Different reasons can sit behind the same side
title.zh: 同一侧方案也可能出于不同理由

paragraphs.en: You might prefer tax-financed education because you want access less dependent on household resources. You might choose an optional civic ceremony because you want participation to be voluntary. Those reasons can coexist, but the selections alone do not prove them. Another respondent could choose the same education proposal for administrative convenience and the same ceremony proposal because the event seems unimportant. Record your reasons separately if they matter to you. The questionnaire counts the chosen alternatives equally and does not infer motives, personal virtue or an undisclosed hierarchy among issues.
paragraphs.zh: 你可能为了减少家庭资源对机会的影响而支持公共教育筹资，也可能因为重视自愿性而选择可自由退出的公民仪式。两种理由可以并存，但选项本身不能证明它们。别人可能只是为了行政便利选择相同的教育方案，又因为觉得仪式不重要而选择相同选项。如需保留理由，应另外记录。本题本等权计数，不推断动机、品德，也不擅自替你排列议题的重要性。

title.en: Calculate a point without percentages
title.zh: 用原始次数计算，不变成百分比

paragraphs.en: Imagine fourteen economic-left choices and four economic-right choices, alongside six communitarian and twelve liberal choices. The economic calculation is four minus fourteen, giving −10. The social calculation is twelve minus six, giving +6. With eighteen valid choices on each axis the chart shows (−10, +6). That is not ten units left of an average citizen, nor sixty percent liberal. Moving one social response from liberal to communitarian produces eleven and seven, reducing the social difference to +4 while leaving the economic count unchanged.
paragraphs.zh: 假设经济左向十四次、右向四次，社会轴共同体优先六次、个人自由优先十二次。经济差值为4−14＝−10，社会差值为12−6＝+6。每轴十八项有效，因此可显示（−10，+6）。这不是比平均公民“左十个单位”，也不是“自由程度百分之六十”。将一项社会回答从个人自由优先改为共同体优先后，次数为十一与七，社会差值变为+4，经济次数不变。

title.en: A narrow difference does not settle the debate
title.zh: 小差值不等于议题已经定论

paragraphs.en: At eight left and ten right selections the economic value is +2, even if the proposals you care about most were among the eight left selections. This illustrates why count size cannot substitute for personal importance. Nine to nine is a valid economic tie and retains both liberal-side readings. One NA instead means the eighteen-item axis is not complete, so no economic count summary or combined point is shown. All four guides remain available in either case. A missing coordinate is a legitimate outcome, not a reason to guess an answer.
paragraphs.zh: 若经济左向八次、右向十次，差值为+2，即使你最看重的议题恰好都在八项左向选择里。次数多少不能替代重要程度。九比九是有效并列，个人自由优先一侧的两份读法都保留；一项NA则使十八题轴不完整，不显示该轴个人次数汇总或组合点。无论哪种情况，四份指南都可阅读。没有坐标是可以保留的结果，不必猜答。

title.en: Voluntary participation need not imply private financing
title.zh: 自愿参与不必然要求私人筹资

paragraphs.en: A person can favor individually chosen cultural observances while supporting tax-funded transport. They may see public infrastructure as enabling people to pursue different goals. Another person can favor the same cultural choice but prefer user charges and private investment; that leads toward the economic-right and liberal comparison. The social response does not decide the economic one. Equally, support for a public broadcaster does not settle whether its programming should sustain a common tradition or offer plural choices. Read the particular instrument before treating two familiar political words as a single package.
paragraphs.zh: 有人支持个人自选文化纪念日，同时支持税收筹资的公共交通，认为公共基础设施能帮助人们追求不同目标。另一个人赞成同样的文化安排，却偏好使用者付费和私人投资，经济方向便可能不同。社会回答并不决定经济回答。支持公共广播，也不能自动决定节目应维护共同传统还是扩大多元选择。需要先看具体工具，不能把两个熟悉政治词汇直接捆成一套立场。

title.en: Test whether the means support the stated goal
title.zh: 检查手段能否支持目标

paragraphs.en: Public funding can broaden access while creating decisions about taxation, eligibility and accountability. Neutral civic rules can protect different choices while leaving some communities worried about continuity. These are questions to investigate, not outcomes established by the score. Ask who decides the funding terms, how a person can challenge an exclusion, and whether an apparently neutral rule works similarly for people with different resources. Answers require information about institutions and circumstances that the questionnaire does not collect. A larger count in either direction does not remove the need for that information.
paragraphs.zh: 公共筹资可能扩大可及性，同时带来税负、资格和问责的选择；中立公民规则可能保护多样选择，也可能让某些共同体担忧延续。这些需要调查，不能由分数证明。可以检查谁决定筹资条件、被排除者怎样申诉，以及中立规则对不同资源条件的人是否同样可用。答案依赖本问卷没有收集的制度和情境信息，某侧次数较多也不能免去这些核查。

title.en: Describe a condition that would change one answer
title.zh: 写出改变一项选择的条件

paragraphs.en: Select one proposal you supported only reluctantly. What additional safeguard, cost estimate or access provision would make the other proposal more acceptable? Describe that condition without naming a person you want to persuade. Then read a neighboring guide and check whether it identifies a concern you left out. This is a way to examine your own reasoning, not a program for changing someone else’s politics. You can stop after the comparison. The result supplies no candidate, party, campaign, donation or voting recommendation and makes no prediction about political behavior.
paragraphs.zh: 选出一项勉强支持的方案，写下另一方案需要补上什么保障、成本估算或参与条件，才会更能被你接受。围绕自己的理由描述即可，无须指定要说服谁。再读一份相邻指南，看看是否遗漏了某种顾虑。这用于检查自己的推理，不用于改变别人的政治倾向；比较后可以结束。结果不提供候选人、政党、政治活动、捐款或投票建议，也不预测政治行为。

title.en: Read an original policy-choice edition
title.zh: 按原创政策取舍版本理解

paragraphs.en: The thirty-six prompts, bilingual proposals, equal weights and boundary rules are authored for this FermatMind edition. General political theory supplies vocabulary, not a validated scoring key. We have not established test–retest reliability, population norms or Chinese–English measurement equivalence. Scores from another political quiz cannot be substituted into this chart. Public guide links carry no personal answer vector or coordinate. Saving is optional, limited to this browser tab and cleared when an attempt is completed or restarted. Reading the other full guides does not alter the arithmetic of your choices.
paragraphs.zh: 三十六道题、双语方案、等权规则和边界规则均为费马本版原创。一般政治理论提供词汇背景，不提供经过验证的计分键。本版没有建立重测信度、人口常模或中英文测量等价证据，其他政治问卷的分数不能代入本图。公开指南链接不携带个人答案向量或坐标；进度自愿保存于本标签页，完成或重测时清除。阅读其他完整指南不会改变本次选择的算术结果。

title.en: Economic Left & Liberal: Political Coordinates
title.zh: 经济左向×个人自由优先：本题本读法｜原创政治坐标

description.en: Read economic-left and socially liberal choices, from public financing to voluntary civic participation. Follow the coordinate example, ties and NA rules.
description.zh: 本组合对应经济左向方案较多、社会轴个人自由优先方案也较多。它描述的是所给方案的选择，不换算成政党标签，也不概括你的全部信念。

title.en: Economic-right × communitarian: reading these choices
title.zh: 经济右向×共同体优先：本题本读法

headline.en: Compare more private economic choice with stronger shared civic expectations.
headline.zh: 分别看更多私人经济选择，以及更强的共同公民要求。

summary.en: More private financing or owner discretion on the economic items can occur alongside more shared obligations and cultural continuity on the social items. This is one comparison of this bank’s choices, with no automatic party, national or moral identity.
summary.zh: 经济题中更多私人筹资或所有者自主，可以与社会题中更多共同义务、文化延续并存。这只是本题本的一个选择组合，不自动指定政党、国家或道德身份。

scoreReading.en: Here the right-minus-left economic difference is positive and the liberal-minus-communitarian social difference is negative. Each axis is counted separately out of eighteen valid selections. Missing information is never scored as a tie.
scoreReading.zh: 这里经济的右减左差值为正，社会的个人自由优先减共同体优先差值为负。每轴以十八项有效选择分别计数；资料不足不算并列。

title.en: Economic discretion and shared civic purposes
title.zh: 经济自主与共同公民目的

paragraphs.en: On the economic axis, the proposals called right in this edition give more room to private financing, owner control, individual contracts or retention of earnings. On the social axis, communitarian proposals place more weight on common civic obligations and the continuity of shared public practices. These dimensions ask different questions. A preference for less public financing does not establish a wish for fewer civic expectations, and valuing community does not establish support for public ownership. The comparison describes selections between specified alternatives, not a complete theory of government or a fixed human type.
paragraphs.zh: 本版经济右向方案给予私人筹资、所有者控制、个人合同或所得保留更多空间；社会轴共同体优先方案则更重视共同公民义务与共享公共实践的延续。两轴问的不是同一个问题。偏好较少公共筹资，不等于偏好较少公民要求；重视共同体，也不能推出赞成公共所有。这个组合只描述给定方案之间的选择，不是一套完整的政府理论，更不是固定的人格类型。

title.en: Check who holds economic and civic authority
title.zh: 分别检查经济与公民决策由谁作出

paragraphs.en: An answer favoring private ownership assigns one kind of authority to owners and contracts. An answer favoring a common civic charter assigns another kind of authority to a public account of shared purposes. The coexistence of these preferences can be deliberate, but it can also hide unresolved questions about accountability. Would a privately run service still need to meet a community obligation? Who decides what counts as a shared purpose? The item counts cannot answer either question. Use them to locate the particular choices that deserve closer explanation rather than assuming the package already resolves every institutional tension.
paragraphs.zh: 选择私人所有，是把某种决定权交给所有者和合同；选择共同公民章程，则把另一种决定权交给公开形成的共同目的。这种搭配可能经过考虑，也可能留下尚未解决的问责问题：私人经营的服务要承担哪些共同义务？谁有权确定共同目的？次数不能回答这些问题。可以借汇总定位需要补充理由的具体题目，而不是认为一个组合已经解决了所有制度张力。

title.en: Recompute a mixed-direction coordinate
title.zh: 复算一正一负的坐标

paragraphs.en: A fictional respondent chooses five economic-left proposals and thirteen economic-right proposals. On the social axis they choose twelve communitarian and six liberal proposals. The economic difference is thirteen minus five, or +8. The social difference is six minus twelve, or −6. All thirty-six selections are valid, so a point at (+8, −6) can be shown. If one economic-right response changes to left, the counts become twelve and six and the economic difference becomes +6. That two-count movement results from changing both sides of one comparison, not from a hidden weight.
paragraphs.zh: 假设经济左向五次、右向十三次，社会轴共同体优先十二次、个人自由优先六次。经济差值为13−5＝+8，社会差值为6−12＝−6。三十六项全部有效，因此显示（+8，−6）。若一项经济右向回答改为左向，次数变为十二与六，经济差值变为+6。这一次选择让两侧各变化一次，所以差值变化二；并没有隐藏权重。

title.en: A zero axis keeps comparisons open
title.zh: 零轴让比较保持开放

paragraphs.en: If the economic count is nine to nine, the point lies on the social axis and both communitarian-side economic readings remain available as boundary comparisons. If the social count is nine to nine, both right-side social readings remain relevant. Two zero differences retain all four comparisons rather than awarding a special neutral personality. By contrast, a single NA on an axis means that axis lacks eighteen valid selections, so its counts and difference are withheld. Even an extreme-looking set of the other seventeen answers cannot fill in the missing response.
paragraphs.zh: 经济次数九比九时，点落在社会轴上，共同体优先一侧的两种经济组合都保留；社会次数九比九时，经济右向一侧的两种社会组合都保留。双零意味着四份比较均保留，不产生特殊的“中立人格”。一项NA则使所属轴缺少十八项有效选择，不显示该轴次数和差值。即使另外十七项看起来方向非常集中，也不能替缺失回答作推断。

title.en: The same public tradition can accompany another economy
title.zh: 同一种公共传统也能搭配不同经济安排

paragraphs.en: Two people may both support a shared civic calendar and a public ceremony. One may prefer lower investment taxes and private retirement accounts, while the other prefers a larger public pension and more redistribution. Their social selections could match while their economic counts diverge. Likewise, choosing private retirement finance does not imply a wish to require participation in a ceremony. These contrasts show why a single label would lose information. The bank also leaves many relevant policies unasked, so even identical pairs of counts can conceal markedly different priorities and reasons.
paragraphs.zh: 两个人都可能支持共享公民日历与公共仪式，一个偏好较低投资税和私人退休账户，另一个偏好更大的公共退休保障与更多再分配。社会选择相近，经济次数仍会分开。选择私人退休筹资，也不表示想要求别人参加仪式。单一标签会丢失这些区别，而且题本没有询问所有相关政策；即使两轴次数完全一样，优先顺序与理由也可能明显不同。

title.en: Consider voluntary cooperation and enforceable duties
title.zh: 同时考虑自愿合作与可执行的义务

paragraphs.en: A privately financed arrangement may offer discretion while creating access or bargaining problems. A shared civic expectation may support continuity while restricting people who dissent or belong to a different tradition. Whether those concerns arise depends on details the quiz does not test. Ask how service users can challenge terms, how minority views enter a community decision, and which obligations are voluntary or enforceable. Neither market choice nor a statement of common purpose automatically supplies those safeguards. The result cannot certify the fairness, efficiency or legitimacy of an actual institution.
paragraphs.zh: 私人筹资可能增加自主，也可能带来可及性或议价难题；共同公民要求可能支持延续，也可能限制持异议或不同传统的人。实际是否出现这些问题，取决于本问卷没有检验的细节。可以检查服务使用者怎样质疑条款、少数意见怎样进入共同决定，以及哪些义务自愿、哪些具有强制性。市场选择和共同目的声明都不能自动提供保障，结果也不认证真实制度的公平、效率或正当性。

title.en: Name the condition behind one difficult choice
title.zh: 说明一道难题背后的条件

paragraphs.en: Take a civic obligation you selected and write down the exemption or appeal process you would consider essential. Then take a private-financing proposal and specify the access protection you would require before supporting it in practice. These notes make qualifications visible that a count cannot carry. You may discover that the two offered alternatives were too narrow; keeping NA or reading the adjacent full guide is reasonable. There is no requirement to resolve the tension today. This page does not direct you toward a political organization or suggest how to persuade anyone based on a score.
paragraphs.zh: 挑出一项你选择的公民义务，写出你认为不可缺少的豁免或申诉程序；再挑出一项私人筹资方案，说明实际支持之前需要哪些可及性保障。这能保留次数没有表达的条件。也可能发现题中两个方案过于有限，此时保留NA或阅读相邻完整指南都可以，不必今天就消除张力。本页不引导加入政治组织，也不依据分数设计说服他人的方式。

title.en: Keep the edition and its limits explicit
title.zh: 明确版本及其解释边界

paragraphs.en: This is an original FermatMind bilingual policy-choice bank with equal item counts, not a licensed reproduction of a proprietary political questionnaire. Political-theory references explain general concepts and do not supply evidence of this edition’s reliability, validity or cultural equivalence. A positive coordinate is simply the direction chosen for drawing the chart, not a better result. No percentage, population rank, leader comparison or party assignment is calculated. Public explanations omit personal counts and answers; copying a guide shares only that explanation. Optional tab progress expires and is cleared on completion or retake.
paragraphs.zh: 本版为费马原创双语政策取舍题本，采用等权次数，不是专有政治问卷的许可复制。政治理论参考只解释一般概念，不证明本版信度、效度或文化等价。正坐标只是画图时规定的方向，不表示更好的结果。程序不计算百分比、人口排名、领导者对照或政党归属。公开说明没有个人次数和答案，复制指南只分享说明；自愿保存的标签页进度会到期，完成或重测也会清除。

title.en: Economic Right & Communitarian: Political Coordinates
title.zh: 经济右向×共同体优先：本题本读法｜原创政治坐标

description.en: Read economic-right and communitarian choices: private financing alongside shared civic duties. Explore a worked point, boundary ties, NA and trade-offs.
description.zh: 经济题中更多私人筹资或所有者自主，可以与社会题中更多共同义务、文化延续并存。这只是本题本的一个选择组合，不自动指定政党、国家或道德身份。

title.en: Economic-right × liberal: reading these choices
title.zh: 经济右向×个人自由优先：本题本读法

headline.en: Read private economic discretion alongside voluntary civic participation.
headline.zh: 分别理解私人经济自主与自愿的公民参与。

summary.en: This comparison brings together more economic-right proposals and more liberal proposals on the separate social axis. It reports the pattern of these selections without measuring ideological purity, political knowledge or a real-world group identity.
summary.zh: 本组合对应经济右向方案较多、独立社会轴上个人自由优先方案也较多。它汇报本题选择的方向，不测意识形态纯度、政治知识或真实群体身份。

scoreReading.en: Both differences are positive: economic right minus left and social liberal minus communitarian. A zero difference preserves adjacent comparisons. An axis with any NA has no personal counts or coordinate, even when the other axis is complete.
scoreReading.zh: 经济右减左、社会个人自由优先减共同体优先，两项差值均为正。零差值保留相邻比较；某轴只要有NA，就不显示该轴个人次数或坐标，即使另一轴完整。

title.en: Two kinds of discretion, separately counted
title.zh: 两种自主空间分别计数

paragraphs.en: The economic proposals on this side favor more private financing, individual contracting, owner discretion or retention of income. The social proposals on this side favor more voluntary civic participation, neutral eligibility rules or individual freedom to revise common commitments. Similar language about choice appears in both domains, but the mechanisms differ. A market contract concerns resources and bargaining conditions; a civic rule concerns the standing of different people and purposes in public life. Combining their counts does not demonstrate that one principle explains every selection or that the same policy works in every setting.
paragraphs.zh: 这一侧经济方案更偏向私人筹资、个别合同、所有者自主或保留所得；社会方案更偏向自愿公民参与、中立资格规则或个人审视共同承诺的自由。两边都可能出现“选择”的语言，但机制不同：市场合同涉及资源与议价条件，公民规则涉及不同个人和目的在公共生活中的地位。把次数放在一张图上，不能证明每道选择都出于同一原则，也不能证明同一政策适用于所有情境。

title.en: Examine the meaning of choice in each proposal
title.zh: 逐题检查“选择”究竟意味着什么

paragraphs.en: Choosing user charges for transport is not the same decision as allowing optional participation in a ceremony. The first changes how a service is financed; the second changes whether a shared public practice is expected of an individual. You may support each for different reasons and attach different conditions. The questionnaire does not ask your income, background or personal exposure to a policy and cannot infer those conditions. Check whether your preferred option supplies meaningful alternatives, who can use them and which constraints remain, rather than reading the repeated word freedom as a complete explanation.
paragraphs.zh: 选择公共交通由使用者多付费，与选择公民仪式自愿参加，并不是同一件事：前者改变服务筹资方式，后者改变个人是否被期待遵循共同公共实践。你可能出于不同理由支持它们，也可能附带不同条件。本问卷没有收集收入、背景或政策影响经历，不能推断这些条件。可以检查方案是否提供实际可用的替代选择、谁能使用、还有哪些约束，而不是把反复出现的“自由”当作完整解释。

title.en: Follow an example through one answer change
title.zh: 跟着算例检查一次改答

paragraphs.en: Suppose an attempt contains seven left and eleven right economic choices, with five communitarian and thirteen liberal social choices. Economic right minus left is eleven minus seven, or +4. Social liberal minus communitarian is thirteen minus five, or +8. The complete point is (+4, +8). Changing one economic-right answer to left makes ten right and eight left, so the economic difference becomes +2. None of this establishes that the original social preference was twice as important as the economic preference; the axes count different sets of proposals.
paragraphs.zh: 假设经济左向七次、右向十一次，社会轴共同体优先五次、个人自由优先十三次。经济差值为11−7＝+4，社会差值为13−5＝+8，完整坐标为（+4，+8）。把一项经济右向回答改成左向后，次数为十与八，经济差值变成+2。这不说明社会取舍比经济取舍重要两倍；两轴计算的是两组不同方案，不能比较心理重要程度。

title.en: Leave both balance and uncertainty visible
title.zh: 让均衡与不确定都保持可见

paragraphs.en: Nine right and nine left selections produce a valid zero, even if the choices were strongly felt. Nine liberal and nine communitarian selections also produce zero, even if the person has clear views on every item. A centered dot therefore does not prove indifference or political moderation. Any NA has a different meaning: the relevant eighteen-choice count is not complete and no point is drawn until both axes are complete. The report still provides all four full guides. You do not need to turn uncertainty into a side choice to unlock an explanation.
paragraphs.zh: 右向与左向九比九得到有效零值，即使每一题的态度都很明确；个人自由优先与共同体优先九比九也一样。图中心不证明冷漠或政治温和。NA的含义不同：所属十八题轴不完整，两轴都完整前不画组合点。报告依然提供四份完整指南，不必把不确定改成某一侧，才能获得说明。

title.en: Private choice can coexist with public provision
title.zh: 个人自由也可以与公共供给并存

paragraphs.en: An individual can reject a compulsory civic-service scheme yet favor a larger publicly financed retirement benefit. That combines a liberal social choice with an economic-left choice rather than contradicting a principle the test has diagnosed. Another individual can favor privately owned infrastructure but also favor an expected common civic ceremony. The bank permits those combinations because neither axis is a proxy for the other. Even within one axis, a person may prefer different arrangements for water, childcare and education. The total cannot show those differences without returning to the selected proposals.
paragraphs.zh: 一个人可以反对强制公民服务，同时支持更大的公共退休待遇，这形成个人自由优先与经济左向的搭配，并不是违背了测试“诊断”的原则。另一个人可以支持私人持有基础设施，同时赞成共同公民仪式。两轴互不代理，因此允许不同组合。同一轴内，供水、照护和教育也可能各自采用不同安排；只看汇总无法看出这些区别，仍需回到具体方案。

title.en: Look beyond formal permission
title.zh: 检查形式上的许可是否足够

paragraphs.en: A policy can permit individual choice while practical constraints make some options difficult to use. Private financing can bring flexibility and also raise questions about affordability and bargaining power. Neutral civic access rules can protect dissent while leaving unresolved how to support a shared cultural practice. These are matters for evidence and institutional design, not automatic deductions from a coordinate. Ask what information, appeal process and access conditions would be necessary for the offered choice to be meaningful. The questionnaire provides no factual estimate of costs, benefits or the effects of adopting either proposal.
paragraphs.zh: 政策可以在形式上允许个人选择，但现实约束仍使某些选项难以使用。私人筹资可能带来灵活性，也带来可负担性和议价能力的问题；中立公民参与规则可以保护异议，也仍需考虑共同文化实践怎样维系。这些依赖证据和制度设计，不能从坐标自动推出。可以检查有意义的选择需要哪些信息、申诉渠道和参与条件。本问卷不估算采用任一方案的成本、收益或实际效果。

title.en: Compare an alternative without recruiting a viewpoint
title.zh: 比较替代方案，不把读法变成动员

paragraphs.en: Pick a proposal where neither option felt adequate and draft a third option in one or two sentences. Explain what it retains from each side, what it sacrifices and what information you would need before accepting it. Then compare your note with the neighboring guide or leave the item as NA on a new attempt. This exercise concerns your own understanding of the offered choices. It is not an instruction to recruit people with similar scores, tailor political messages or select an organization. All four guides are equally available, and ending the exercise is a complete next step.
paragraphs.zh: 选一道两个选项都不满意的题，用一两句话写出第三方案：各保留什么、牺牲什么，以及接受之前还需要哪些信息。可以与相邻边界指南比较，也可以在重测时保留NA。这只是理解自己的方案取舍，不要求招募分数相近的人、定制政治信息或选择组织。四份指南同样开放，直接结束也是完整的下一步。

title.en: No purity score or cross-quiz conversion
title.zh: 不生成纯度，也不跨题本换算

paragraphs.en: FermatMind Editorial authored this equal-count, thirty-six-item bilingual edition. References on political concepts provide context without establishing psychometric validity, population norms or equivalence across languages and cultures. This report is not the Libertarian Purity Test or another instrument, and it does not convert political quiz scores into one another. A positive sign is a drawing convention, not approval. Public links omit private counts, coordinates and answers. Optional progress is saved only in the current tab for up to twenty-four hours and clears when an attempt finishes, is cleared or is restarted.
paragraphs.zh: 本等权三十六题双语版本由费马测试编辑部原创。政治概念参考提供背景，不建立心理测量效度、人口常模或跨语言文化等价。本报告不是自由意志主义纯度测试或其他量表，不在政治问卷之间换算分数；正号只是画图约定，不代表赞许。公开链接不包含私人次数、坐标和答案。自愿保存的进度仅存在当前标签页，最长二十四小时，完成、清除或重测时删除。

title.en: Economic Right & Liberal: Political Coordinates
title.zh: 经济右向×个人自由优先：本题本读法｜原创政治坐标

description.en: Explore economic-right and socially liberal choices, including private financing and voluntary civic participation. Read a worked point, ties and NA.
description.zh: 本组合对应经济右向方案较多、独立社会轴上个人自由优先方案也较多。它汇报本题选择的方向，不测意识形态纯度、政治知识或真实群体身份。
